name: Friendly
overview: Scripture highlights the beauty and goodness of living in unity and friendliness, as seen in Psalms 133:1, which celebrates the pleasantness of brethren dwelling together in harmony. This friendly unity reflects the love commanded by Christ in Mark 12:31, urging believers to love their neighbors as themselves. The foundation of this community is secured by Christ Himself, as Matthew 16:18 affirms the church's enduring strength against opposition. Together, these verses emphasize that friendliness is rooted in love, unity, and the steadfast work of Christ among His people.
